info.title: Global Plastic Trading Intelligence API
info.description: B2B intelligence for LDPE / LLDPE / HDPE (virgin, near-prime, off-grade, recycled) and market price tracking for commodity polymers across India, China, the USA and other markets. All records are traceable to their source; nothing is fabricated.

post.description: Public endpoint (no auth) so data subjects can request opt-out, correction or deletion.
Upload a permitted CSV/XLSX export. kind = companies | shipments. origin_source = source key the export came from.

get.description: Random auto-classified material rows for manual accuracy review.

delete.description: Deletes personal data. With suppress=true the email/phone is hashed onto the suppression list so it is never re-collected.

get.description: Supplier -> buyer relationships aggregated from shipment records.
Latest price of every tracked series, with moves and a value normalised to `currency`/`unit`.
Every priced series of one material (e.g. LLDPE in India, China, USA) normalised to one currency/unit.

post.description: Manual FX rate (units of currency per 1 USD), for currencies without an automatic feed.
Manual price entry, e.g. from a producer price circular. State the basis (ex-works, GST...) in `note`.

CSV/XLSX with columns series_key, date, price[, low, high, note, source_url]. `series_key` form field
applies to files that have no series column.
Queue (or run immediately) all enabled price connectors.
